problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing campaigns

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Educate employees on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Use email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Limit publicly available personal information on social media

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees or partners.
risk_reduction: Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Enable MFA on all business email accounts
Monitor email account activity for unusual login patterns

problems.description: Exposure of sensitive data due to improperly configured cloud storage services such as AWS S3 buckets or Azure Blob Storage, leading to data leaks or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement automated cloud configuration and compliance scanning
Enforce least privilege access policies and role-based access control
Enable logging and monitoring of cloud storage access

problems.description: Attackers compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms in third-party software to inject malicious code that propagates to downstream users.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and dependency scanning
Use code signing and verify update integrity
Monitor for anomalous behavior post-update

problems.description: Use of AI to craft highly convincing and personalized phishing messages at scale, increasing the success rate of social engineering attacks.
risk_reduction: Deploy advanced detection tools that analyze linguistic patterns
Increase user awareness of AI-generated content risks
Use multi-factor authentication to mitigate credential theft

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model inputs to degrade machine learning model performance or cause incorrect predictions.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training data
Implement robust model monitoring and anomaly detection
Use adversarial training and model hardening techniques

problems.description: Attackers not only encrypt victim data but also exfiltrate sensitive information and threaten public release to increase pressure for ransom payment.
risk_reduction: Maintain offline backups and test recovery procedures
Implement network segmentation and least privilege access
Deploy data loss prevention (DLP) and monitor for exfiltration
